summary: Frontend-only regression PASS at https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 390x844). NEW 'Overhead Now' panel on the Flights tab renders correctly in every state and does NOT regress any other Flights functionality. (1) EMPTY STATE (no ZIP): the 'Overhead Now' section label + card render ABOVE the 'Flight Tracking' master toggle (Overhead Y=190 vs Flight Tracking Y=303) with the 'Set your ZIP below to see planes near you.' copy + location-outline icon. No refresh icon shown while unlocated (matches code: `{located && ...}`). (2) POST-ZIP STATE: entering '28117' geocodes to 'Mooresville, NC  ·  35.584, -80.868' as before, the Overhead Now card flips to the graceful fallback 'No aircraft in range right now. (Live view needs the phone app.)' with the airplane-outline icon — this is EXPECTED per the review brief because adsb.lol is CORS-blocked in the web preview (console shows 'Access to fetch at https://api.adsb.lol/v2/lat/35.584/lon/-80.8685/dist/22 ... has been blocked by CORS policy'). The refresh icon (Ionicons U+f514) appears in the Overhead Now header next to the label as expected. (3) AUTO-REFRESH: waited 22s to cross the 20s setInterval boundary — the CORS error re-fires but the screen does NOT red-screen, the Overhead Now card and card stay mounted, and no pageerror is emitted. (4) REGRESSION on Flights tab: ZIP still populates 'Mooresville, NC · lat, lon'; slider still reads '25 mi' with '1 mi'/'100 mi' scale text; 'Follow one flight' toggle reveals the callsign TextInput and 'Landing alert' toggle; typing 'aa1234' auto-uppercases to 'AA1234'; after a full page reload aura_settings_v1 in localStorage confirms {flights:{zip:'28117', city:'Mooresville', state:'NC', lat:35.584, lon:-80.8685, radiusMi:25, trackFlight:true, flightIdent:'AA1234', landingAlert:true}} — all persisted. (5) REGRESSION overall: all 4 tabs (Device/Flights/Sports/Weather) load with no red-screen; SYNC FAB shows an info toast 'BLE needs a real device build to sync.' when disconnected. No new pageerrors; only long-standing shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver deprecation warnings from prior iterations. adsb.lol + ESPN CORS blocks are expected on web (device-only features) and are NOT bugs.

critical_code_review_comments: flights.tsx:66-77 loadPlanes uses a monotonic fetchIdRef guard (`id !== fetchIdRef.current` return) to drop late responses. Combined with the 20s setInterval + cleanup on unmount (line 82-83) this correctly prevents state updates on unmounted screens and correctly races between the initial fetch, radius-change fetch, and periodic refresh. Good.
flights.tsx:79-84 useEffect only starts the interval once located (lat/lon != null), which means the empty pre-ZIP state does NOT spam fetches. Correct.

flights.tsx:96-111 refresh icon vs. ActivityIndicator switch is gated on `located` first, then on `planesLoading`. That is correct — while unlocated no icon is shown (verified in DOM), which matches the empty-state design. The refresh Ionicon uses onPress={loadPlanes} which will fire even mid-load; not harmful because of the fetchIdRef guard, but consider disabling while planesLoading for polish.

adsb.ts:36-46 fetchWithTimeout catches AbortError and network errors and returns null — nearbyPlanes() then returns [] cleanly, which is why the CORS block turns into the graceful fallback rather than an unhandled promise rejection or red-screen. Good defensive coding.

adsb.ts:34, 57 routeCache is a module-level Map with a 6h TTL. Fine — but note the cache never gets purged and will grow unbounded across long sessions. Non-blocking. Consider LRU cap of ~200 entries if this ever runs on-device for days.

adsb.ts:120-130 route enrichment runs in parallel via Promise.all over the top-4 planes and mutates each Plane object in place. Safe because the array is local to nearbyPlanes and is returned only after all enrichments settle.
flights.tsx:126-150 plane row rendering keys off (callsign + i) — if two aircraft share callsigns momentarily, React still gets unique keys. Fine.

airlineLogoUrl uses gstatic.com/flights/airline_logos/70px/{iata}.png — 70px is a valid gstatic size, so no broken-image on device builds. On web preview no plane rows render (fallback path), so this is not exercised — verified only via code review.
